title: REQ · AdminApp no longer imports, renders or calls anything execution-related
summary: AdminApp drops ExecutionPanel, execution state, the executions fetch and approve/retry/reject handlers
description: AdminApp.tsx imports ExecutionPanel and approve/retry/reject/listExecutions/findExecutionForRound and ExecutionInfo; it holds execution, actionError, actionDetail state, fetches executions in its load effect, defines runExecutionAction and renders ExecutionPanel. All of this is removed; the stepper uses the round status alone and the load effect fetches only the round and contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid token and an OPEN round, when AdminApp loads, then fetch is never called with /api/v1/admin/executions
Given a CLOSED round, when AdminApp loads, then the stepper shows the CLOSED step as current
Given a 401 from the round or contributions call, when AdminApp loads, then the token gate shows Invalid token
Given AdminApp source, when searched, then it has no Execution, approve, retry or reject identifiers

preserve: Round controls, world title, duration and limit fields, contributions list, handleError 401 behavior

technical_constraints: Keep LifecycleStepper and deriveStage exports unchanged
definition_of_done: Admin tests for kept behavior pass
